description: “We cannot forget that agents of some of our state’s most critical law enforcement agencies fall under this specific peace officer status, such as Correction Officers and Court Officers. These retired law enforcement officers are granted a concealed carry license because during their careers they may have received threats due to their work and those potential threats extend into their retirement.”

title: Statement from Assemblymember Reilly on the passage of an amendment to exempt certain retired peace officers from the state’s sensitive location law – Mike Reilly for State Assembly
